newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish shares end lower nervously eyeing overseas.
newsitem.headline: Finnish shares end lower nervously eyeing overseas.

text.p: The Helsinki bourse fell on Tuesday depressed by weak overseas markets following the escalation of the conflict in Iraq, brokers said.
The HEX all-share index shed 1.6 percent to end at 2,100.14 points. Decliners led advancers by almost five-to-one in moderately active 360 million markka trade.
Oil and energy group Neste ended 2.00 markka lower at 97.00 markka on fears that the jump in crude oil prices caused by the Iraq crisis would hit profits.
Telecoms group Nokia fell 3.50 markka to 186.50.
Banking group Merita fell to a new year-low close 9.15 markka, down 0.15.
The stock market ignored the 1997 state budget proposal and an EMU convergence programme released by the government, brokers said.
